'''''Star Wars: Obsession''''' is a series of comics published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. It ran from [[November 24]], [[2004]] to [[May 18]], [[2005]]. The concept of the series was to lead directly into [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|Episode III]], but publication delays prolonged the release of the final issue until the day before the release of the film.
